description: Home both Z axes against their limit switches and register the travel lengths in centimeters.

inputs.label: Left Z Track Length (cm)

inputs.description: Physical usable right Z travel from origin to max limit in centimeters.

inputs.description: Speed preset used while probing the Z limits.
